title: lycopodium clavatum var. tristachyum
intro: Lycopodium clavatum var. tristachyum, commonly known as Eastern Club Moss, is a type of plant that belongs to the Lycopodiaceae family and is native to Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can help in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Eastern Club Moss include expectorant and bronchodilator effects, which can aid in relieving respiratory congestion and promoting smooth breathing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
